resources.string: Wake your NB-100 and disconnect the official Plaud app before scanning. Discovery leaves your recordings and pairing unchanged.
Scan stopped. You can scan again.
Bluetooth discovery permission is needed. Tap Scan to try again.
Bluetooth LE is unavailable on this device.
Turn on Bluetooth, then scan again.
Turn on Location in Android settings to scan on this Android version.
Bluetooth scan failed (%1$d). Try again shortly.
Firmware compatibility has not been checked.
Enter the HTTPS address reachable through your phone’s WireGuard tunnel. WireGuard remains managed by its own app.
Use a valid HTTPS address and leave the optional token blank or supply a valid token. Resolve any pending instruction before changing the address.
Address saved. Server connectivity has not been checked.
Audio stays on this phone. Recording continues with the screen off; stop here or from the recording notification.
Microphone permission is needed. Tap Start recording to try again.
Permission granted. Tap Start recording to begin.
Recording failed. Captured audio will be recovered where possible.
No audio was captured. Try recording again.
Tap to open Agentix, or Stop to save the recording.
Some recordings could not be read or recovered. Their files have been retained.
Could not open an audio sharing app.
Could not open Agentix Assistant. Open it from the app and check your default assistant setting.
Agentix is your selected voice assistant.
Agentix is not your selected voice assistant.
Choose Agentix under Default apps → Digital assistant app → Default digital assistant app. Then use your configured assistant button or gesture. You can also open it below.
Dictate or type an instruction. Speech recognition stays on this device. Backend actions require explicit enablement in Settings. Pending instructions stay on this device for safe retries.
Microphone permission is needed for Talk. Grant it in App permissions, or type your instruction.
Microphone permission granted. Tap Talk when ready.
Unlock your phone before using the assistant.
The microphone is already in use by Agentix. Stop the other recording or recognition session first.
On-device recognition is unavailable. It requires Android 12 or newer and a compatible installed speech service. You can type instead.
Speech recognition for your device language is unsupported or its offline model is missing. Check your speech service language settings, or type instead.
No final speech was recognized. Tap Talk to retry or type your instruction.
On-device recognition failed. Check your offline speech language and microphone settings, then retry or type instead.
Your instruction is ready, but the Agentix backend is not connected. No action has been taken.
No final response was received. Any pending instruction is retained; retry it to check the outcome.
Offline speech output is unavailable for the selected voice profile. The reply is shown above.
At your service. What would you like me to take care of?
What would you like to ask Gemini? Add the question after “ask Gemini”.
That question is too long to hand off. Please shorten it and try again.
Opened Gemini. Continue your conversation there; you may need to press Send.
Gemini cannot accept a text handoff on this phone. Your question is still in the text box.
An instruction is unresolved. Retry it before sending another. Stopping the wait does not undo server changes.
Assistant state could not be read. Sending is blocked until local storage is recovered.
